_comment: Challenge-2A LANDING mission (NAV-8), profile 'real' (3 HULA drones via pyhulax). Each drone: takeoff (HOLD airborne) -> navigate to its OWN valid pad avoiding the inflated crates -> land_on_pad (visual servo onto the green/valid ArUco pad). DECONFLICTION = TIME + SPACE, NEVER altitude bands: the ~1.1 m ceiling + no-overfly rule make altitude-band separation ILLEGAL. (1) TIME: the SafetyController launch-corridor slot serializes takeoff (one drone in the C2 zone at a time) and the landing slot serializes descent (one drone over the pads at a time) — both bounded waits (launch_slot_wait_s / slot_wait_s), never infinite. (2) SPACE: each drone gets a distinct advisory sector_deg wedge from C2 toward its pad (ADVISORY-only SectorGuard over the dead-reckoned estimate; never a control input). Bands are deliberately ABSENT — the bench/real multi-drone separation guard accepts sector_deg on every drone INSTEAD of distinct bands (config.py). arena_name 'sample' supplies the keep-outs + the C2 launch frame the planner needs; it is the SAMPLE map (test/dry-run geometry) — re-measure + overwrite finals/configs/arenas/sample.json at gate F (tune config, not code). valid_marker_ids per drone are PLACEHOLDER ArUco ids — set them to the briefing's real green-pad markers onsite (gate F). command_timeout_s 30 / mission_budget_s 600 are sized for 3 SERIALIZED takeoffs + transits + SERIALIZED visual landings under real-link latency; the budget is a MAX (the orchestrator exits on all-DONE). PAD MODEL (task #9): pipeline.py trains a landing-pad YOLO detector -> models/pad_v1.pt (single class 'landing_pad', val mAP50 0.984 over 121 train / 30 val frames) — a GITIGNORED data artifact (regenerate onsite with pipeline.py if the C2 laptop lacks it; test_pad_weights_e2e.py decode-checks it through make_ultralytics_detector). This config ships in MARKER servo mode (servo_on default) so the green-suite landing e2e proves beacon-based landing WITHOUT the artifact; to servo onto the VISUAL pad blob instead, apply each zone's _comment_pad and launch with --weights models/pad_v1.pt (forces detector.backend=ultralytics).

guards._comment: launch_slot_wait_s / slot_wait_s: the bounded staggered-launch + serialized-landing corridor waits — generous (each drone may queue behind the other two's takeoff/descent) but FINITE (a stuck corridor raises FlightTimeout, never hangs). landing_reserve_s 60: MissionClockGuard lands all 60 s before the budget so nobody is still airborne at expiry. geofence_radius_m: advisory keep-in over the arena (dead-reckoned, never acted on).

drones._comment: alpha -> pad_north (due north of C2, bearing ~0 deg). Sector centred on its pad bearing, +/-30 deg wedge.

land_on_pad._comment_marker: PLACEHOLDER green-pad ArUco id for pad_north — set to the real briefing marker at gate F.
land_on_pad._comment_pad: PAD-SERVO option (PAD-DETECT): to centre/descend on the YOLO pad BLOB instead of the beacon marker, add "servo_on": "pad", "pad_classes": ["landing_pad"] here AND launch with --weights models/pad_v1.pt. Validity still comes from navigating to THIS pad's beacon region; the beacon ArUco (valid_marker_ids) stays the gate-F safe-code gate. Marker mode (current default) is the e2e-proven fallback.
